name: Staves Long Poles
overview: The Scriptures reveal that staves or long poles served both practical and symbolic purposes. In Zechariah 11:7, two staves named Beauty and Bands symbolize God's care and binding of His people, illustrating a spiritual truth through physical objects. Conversely, in Matthew 26:47 and Mark 14:43, staves are part of the weapons carried by those who came to arrest Jesus, highlighting their use in enforcing authority and conflict. Together, these verses show that staves were tangible tools with both literal and deeper spiritual significance in biblical narrative.
